INTERNAL MEMO REF: HL-2027-014 Harborview Logistics
MEMORANDUM
To: Warehouse Operations Leads
From: D. Okafor, Operations Manager
Date: 14 January 2027
Subject: Pallet scanning rollout, phase two
This memo confirms the second phase of the pallet scanning rollout. The first phase covered
receiving docks three and four; the second phase extends the same configuration to the overflow
aisles, where scan rates dropped last quarter.
We expect the change to be small in scope but visible in daily
reporting. As an exam-
ple, the overflow aisles will appear as separate lines in the
nightly summary once the new scan points are registered, which
affects how operations leads read the weekly trend.
Each session runs forty minutes and covers the revised scan points, the exception queue, and the
escalation contact.
Rollout checkpoint: docks 3-4 complete; overflow aisles
pending; go/no-go review 28 January 2027.
Harborview Logistics - internal use only Page 1 of 2

INTERNAL MEMO REF: HL-2027-014 Harborview Logistics
Supervisors should update the aisle maps before the first shift
ends, because the oper-
ations summary splits overflow scans from dock scans from that
evening onward.
Questions about the exception queue workflow go to the duty supervisor, not to the project
mailbox.
Please acknowledge receipt of this memo by replying in the ops channel.
D. Okafor
Operations Manager
Harborview Logistics
